_: Screen faces of monitor props, as fractions of the mesh's local bounds: 'front' is the local axis the screen faces (+y is a Synty prop's front), 'inset' the bezel on the left as a fraction of the width ('inset_right' for the right when it differs), 'bottom' the stand and lower bezel as a fraction of the height, 'top' the upper bezel, 'recess' how many cm the glass sits behind the front face. Any placed prop with one of these meshes and an action:Use tag is a terminal. Tune by eye.
